meta.name: CCNL Trasporto a Fune (Funivie Terrestri ed Aeree) - ANEF

notes.text: Salary model: split. base_salary = paga base (Allegato 1). fixed_allowances = contingenza (per-level, Allegato 2). No EDR: ilccnl.it Oct-2025 table shows Terzo Elemento = 0.00; totals confirm base + contingenza only (e.g. 2179.27 + 528.67 = 2707.94).
8 livelli retributivi (parametri 210/195/176/160/145/130/120/100 per Art. 18). Sintesi: '8 categorie professionali e altrettanti livelli retributivi'.
Hourly divisor 173 from Art. 18 of the 2025 CCNL text (confirmed thaler.it and lavoro-economia.it).
Additional months: 14 (tredicesima natalizia + quattordicesima luglio, confirmed thaler.it and lavoro-economia.it).

Seniority from Allegato 3 (new-hire amounts, biennale cadence, max 5 scatti). Double-sourced: ilccnl.it Oct-2025 column confirms 1S=70, 1=65, 2=60, 3=55. Allegato 3.1 (pre-30/04/2016 cohort grandfathered amounts) not modelled.
Headcount not verified; no CNEL/ADAPT figure located for I911. INPS-CNEL mapping: I911.

tax_sector=industria: ANEF funivie operators are classified under ATECO H (trasporti) which INPS maps to the industria contribution table. No dedicated 'funivie' or 'trasporto-fune' TaxSector exists in the engine enum; industria is the correct proxy for this transport-infrastructure category.

QUADRI (Art. 5, p. 15 of the 2025 coordinated text): the indennità di funzione of EUR 118.79 a month is paid to the level 1S and 1 workers holding the role 'quadro' (Employment.roles), recognised in writing by the employer.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: fixed allowance IND_FUNZIONE_QUADRO of levels 1S and 1 with role 'quadro', read on 2026-11-05.

notes.text: Allegato 3.1 (grandfathered scatti for workers hired before 30/04/2016) not modelled. Only Allegato 3 (standard post-2016 cohort) amounts implemented. Structural scope decision: pre-2016 grandfathered amounts affect a declining cohort; the new-hire case is exact.

limitation.remediation: Add the Allegato 3.1 amounts for workers hired before 30/04/2016, selected by hire date or a worker fact.

notes.text: Apprenticeship destinations limited to levels 1-6. Level 1S excluded: Quadro status per L. 190/1985 is a person-status designation acquired through individual deed, not a contractually defined apprenticeship destination.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY (Art. 11 c. 13, p. 20 of the CCNL Impianti a fune, testo unico coordinato, https://www.fitcisl.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/CCNL-Impianti-a-Fune-testo-unico-coordinato.pdf, sha256 24f5d87b3468ae8a25bb494f42cf3431764d1740e4cf4b5b3525c573cee62482): 'L’intero periodo di apprendistato professionalizzante è utile ai fini della maturazione dell’anzianità aziendale, anche con riferimento agli aumenti periodici di anzianità che saranno corrisposti nelle misure previste dal livello di appartenenza': seniority_increments.apprentice_level_amount.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

source_document.title: CCNL Impianti a Fune, testo unico coordinato (rinnovo 16 maggio 2025, FIT-CISL)

location.quote: Sono definiti “quadri”, ai sensi della legge 13 maggio 1985, n. 190, i lavoratori individuati, in relazione alle diverse realtà organizzative, tra quelli di livello I super e I [...] A decorrere dalla data di riconoscimento per iscritto della qualifica di quadro da parte dell’azienda, verrà corrisposta ai lavoratori interessati una indennità di funzione di importo pari a € 118,79 mensili, senza assorbimento dell’eventuale superminimo individuale

provenance.transformation: EUR 118.79 a month to a worker of level 1S or 1 holding the role 'quadro' (Employment.roles), from the written recognition of the qualification. A continuous monthly payment, it is part of the ordinary pay of art. 18 c. 2 d) and so of the 13th and 14th months (artt. 20-21) and of the TFR base (art. 35 B, art. 2120 c.c.). The same amount is in art. 5 c. 3 of the CCNL of 6 June 2019 (p. 13): valid from that text; the first date of the amount was not found.

location.section: Art. malattia — integrazione al 100% per 180 giorni

provenance.transformation: Comporto of several illnesses (2026-11-01): the comporto sums the sick days of the months before the day: from 0 months of seniority, 180 days in 24 months, on top of the 180 days of one illness. Source: https://az-apim-cne-sa-0002-lgc-we.azure-api.net/ricerca-api/ricerca/pubblica/accordi/scarica/accordi/105982, p. 25, 26 (sha256 d20eb8268311fb67a0b63fc06e7a44c295ca21fc1c98d5af3ef0d5a1d2b49208): 'Nel caso di interruzione del servizio dovuta a malattia, il lavoratore non in prova ha diritto alla conservazione del posto per un periodo di 180 (centottanta) giorni. Nel caso di più malattie il suddetto periodo di conservazione del posto si intende riferito alle assenze complessivamente verificatesi nei ventiquattro mesi precedenti ogni nuovo ultimo episodio morboso.'

reviews.scope: The Quadri function allowance of Art. 5 (PDF p. 15) of the 2025 coordinated text, text layer, and Art. 5 c. 3 of the 2019 text (p. 13).
findings: Art. 5 c. 3: EUR 118.79 a month to the workers of levels I super and I recognised in writing as Quadri, not absorbed by an individual superminimo; unchanged by the renewals of 19 July 2022 and 16 May 2025.
